readme: I know names are confusing, the reason is that I ported names directly out of the NPCParams from smithbox, some of the nightlords are repeated because they can invade the player during day 1 and 2, others because they have different phases and different models or simply don't have a name (like Caligo was called Unknown). And I'm pretty certain some of the entries here are likely unscaled/unused entities. However as there is no way for me to confirm it at the moment, I'm leaving it as is until hopefully someone more competent makes out a list of the actual IDs then I will filter this sheet accordingly to clean it up, until then... I'm sorry about how messy it looks but you need to bear with it. [fwiw, I'm constantly updating entities whenever I figure the ID and location]
Sheet created and maintained by Recycle. I don't know for how long
If you want access to the sheet to maintain/fix names please don't request editor, contact me first through discord, here is my UserID: 526364220686729222 or through this Contact Form
